title: Conditional kappa 0.001018766833114736: checker-clean chronological gauges and R767 reuse
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Raise the pending conditional candidate from PR #389's `0.000998634658090834606116833` to **`0.001018766833114735805248075`**, exactly
`40750673324589432209923 / 40000000000000000000000000`.
The complex supplier now binds; the target `0.002` has not been achieved.

Reconstruct our R779 complex word and compose the credited shared-donor, re-pivoted, enlarged and ordered entrance constructions. The resulting word has 202 entrance gauges, dimension mass 360 and 551 chronological unit shears. Both unchanged `gx.check1` and `gxcore.mirror` pass. An incompatible target-124/125 transfer is excluded. Chronological omission controls use the literal suffix response and read-before-write invariant; they do not assume that the complete ordered entrance product has square-zero off-diagonal part.

The R767 bit word contains 55 clean-reset reuses and 54 legal frame moves. Every newly allocated helper retains an independent arbitrary dirty column. With the same new complex supplier and the old bit word, the exact fair-control candidate is `0.001016774267814750149837485`; the bit changes improve the composed candidate by `199256529998565541059 / 100000000000000000000000000` and remove that bottleneck.

Update the README, proof, contributor/source credits, research record and pending candidate certificate together. The selected maintainer certificate is not promoted. Preserve the frozen PR #389 package and bind the new witnesses and original vendor bytes by manifests. Three separately scoped exact negative proofs document limits of frozen-center bases, arbitrary rank-eight completions, and fixed first-frame/full-residual bank budgets; none asserts a global impossibility for changed architectures.

This is a finite conditional witness. The all-size compiler, recursive suppliers, compressed Clifford windows, correlated dirty-bank/cover, restored-row, routing, fixed-tape, precision/recovery and analytic interfaces remain assumed. No unconditional multiplication exponent or Lean formalization is claimed.

Credits: applecrusher/Sussman E8 lineage and PR #376; prefix/signed work in #390/#395; Dugongue's response-space/shared-donor work in #401/#404; ordered/enlarged constructions in #409/#410; chafreaky's checker-clean re-pivoting and composition in #412; and the preceding bit/global/outer sources listed in `SOURCE-PINS.json` and the preserved notices. Prepared by ai-nanachi with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Validation

The complete public replay passed locally: full frozen predecessor, reconstructed R779 intermediate, composed chronological word, 6,482 freshly recomputed old/new/reflected Gaussian phase pairs, all 1,019 complex and 1,007 bit local columns, all 1,487 bit global columns, native address phases, physical bank ownership/readback, finite invoices and reserve bridges, two exact rational moment engines, all 47 strict outer inequalities and adverse controls. The selected gen4 full replay and the affected historical joint-dual replay also passed. Independent scope review re-ran both original complex checker families and checked the candidate record.

Reproduce from a clean checkout with Python, C++17 and Boost:

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/e8-clean-reuse-extension/requirements.txt
python -B research/e8-clean-reuse-extension/verify.py /absolute/path/to/fresh/output
python -B research/e8-clean-reuse-extension/record.py
python -B research/e8-structural-frontiers/verify.py /absolute/path/to/another/fresh/output
```

No network, discovery search or cached phase admission is required. The committed Git blobs were checked against every package manifest, including the frozen predecessor; all 158 imported upstream blobs also matched their exact original bytes.

**Linux CI passed on the current commit:** [full Python 3.13/3.14 replay](https://github.com/ai-nanachi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38134463965) passed both jobs, and [52 historical regression jobs](https://github.com/ai-nanachi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38134463961) passed all 52 jobs. Both runs bind commit `88d552526893cd15325948bb1487e9a4d4bf32f6`. CI was running at submission; this paragraph was updated after both runs completed successfully. An earlier CI attempt correctly rejected Git-normalized witness bytes; the subsequent commit preserves those bytes and passes the complete blob/manifest checks. Maintainer review remains pending. Upstream pull-request workflows are awaiting maintainer authorization; these passing runs are on the fork and do not constitute maintainer approval.
